title: Doesn’t Work on Large or Irregularly-Shaped Tomatoes
text: Doesn’t Work on Large or Irregularly-Shaped Tomatoes. This CHEF’N HULLSTER TOMATO HULLER is cute, but it’s a waste of money.  The huller jaws are short and don’t open very wide, so the gadget will only core small, smooth tomatoes (e.g., Early Girl salad tomatoes).  It is useless for coring large slicing tomatoes or irregularly-shaped heirloom tomatoes.

product_metadata.title: Chef'n Hullster Tomato Huller
features: CORE TOMATOES QUICKLY: When you're prepping for dinner, this Chef'n Tomato Huller will come in handy! Easily remove the core from tomatoes, no knife necessary.
STAINLESS STEEL BLADES: The serrated blades are made of stainless steel, so this tomato corer makes light work of coring tomatoes.
EASY TO USE: The Hullster Tomato Corer is easy to use; simply push the button and twist. Voila! A cored tomato in mere seconds.
WORKS WITH A VARIETY OF SIZES: From grape and cherry tomatoes to heirloom and beefsteak, the Chef'n Tomato Huller will easily core your tomatoes.
EASY TO CLEAN: Top-rack dishwasher safe.
description: The Hullster Tomato Huller was specifically designed to core tomatoes quickly. Push the button to extend the stainless steel serrated blades. Insert around the core, release the button and twist. The core comes out quickly and cleanly, perfect for canning or making stuffed tomatoes. Chef’n designs fun and innovative gadgets to encourage exploration in the kitchen, and make pesky cooking tasks more enjoyable. Clever cooking and happy kitchens with Chef’n!
